# External panel (Wikipedia, six languages) under the three quantizers (D-111, exploratory)

`analysis_{gptq,rtnm}/`: the output of the UNCHANGED `scripts/g0/phase1_transfer_report.py` per new arm, small files only (the per-item tables `per_context_*.csv`, 26 MB each, stay outside git, on the private Hugging Face dataset under `runs/gptq-extension/analysis/`). The legacy arm is the committed [`../../../intervention_transfer/results/external/`](../../../intervention_transfer/results/external/). `transfer_*.csv` and `transfer_comparison.md`: the three-arm comparison written by `scripts/g0/gptq_ext/compare_transfer.py --label "external panel, six languages"` (the verdicts are the pre-set rules' own, computed per arm; the contrasts are descriptive; feature level: each arm's own crossed-bootstrap interval; group level: paired by language, so a bootstrap over six languages: very coarse).

Jobs 44209 to 44212 (group level INT4, INT6; 7,200 items, 30 chunks) and 44213 to 44216 (feature level INT4, INT6; 32,030 items, 17 chunks), snapshot `repo_88cfa49`; all eight validated (`gptq_ext/validate_job.py --gate-max-abs 3.0`), full-precision quantities bit-identical to the old external jobs (`bridge_transfer.py`, 0 differing fields). INT16 floors: the old external INT16 directories (the legacy rounding, identical in all arms). Command per arm and the control are in [`../../stage_commands.md`](../../stage_commands.md); the control (same command on the old directories) reproduces all 12 committed legacy files byte for byte. Reading and limits: D-111 in [`../../../decisions_and_anomalies.md`](../../../decisions_and_anomalies.md); plain-language version: section 4.8 of [`../../RESULTS.md`](../../RESULTS.md).
